title: Management Dashboard (Frontend Login + Role UI)
goal: Build frontend authentication flow with login page, role-aware dashboard layout, team management, and reports views.
result_summary: Created AuthContext (JWT in localStorage, login/setup/logout, hasPermission). LoginPage with login + first-time setup toggle. DashboardLayout with role-aware sidebar nav (Chats, Inventory, Team, Reports - visibility based on permissions). TeamManagement with agent table and add-member form (super_boss/manager only). ReportsView with stat cards (total contacts, new today, interactions, active properties, hot leads) and contact type breakdown bar chart. Protected all /api routes with authMiddleware. Added GET /api/agents and GET /api/dashboard/stats endpoints.
